title: Most borrowed books
statementMd:
The five books with the most loans (title and loan count). Break ties by title.

Expected columns: `title`, `loans`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT b.title, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM loans l JOIN books b ON b.id = l.book_id GROUP BY b.id, b.title ORDER BY loans DESC, b.title LIMIT 5;
```
